p: then let him write her a: By this God does not approve light divorcement, but permits it to avoid further inconvenience; Mt 19:7.
defiled: Seeing that by divorcing her he judged her to be unclean and defiled.
neither shall he be charged with: That they might learn to know one another's conditions, and so afterward live in godly peace.
millstone to pledge: Not anything by which a man gets his living.
into his house to fetch his: As though you would appoint what to have, but shall receive what be may spare.
before the LORD thy God: Though he would be unthankful, yet God will not forget it.
stranger: Because the world valued these people least, therefore God has most care over them.
a bondman in the land of: God judged them not mindful of his beasts, unless they were beneficial to others.
